gloss: to advance by winning; to win through

definitions.gloss: to advance by winning; to win through (to the next round)
definitions.explanation: To keep winning in a tournament and so move on to later rounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: They won their way through to the final.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is advancing smoothly through the tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一回戦|いっかいせん}→一回戦：08960_ikkaisen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}→準決勝：04911_junkesshou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}んで⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: The team everyone expected to lose in the first round made headlines by winning its way to the semifinals.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}む / ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}む: to win through to the final
- ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}む: to advance without trouble
- ⟦{準々決勝|じゅんじゅんけっしょう}→準々決勝：25649_junjunkesshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{進|すす}む: to reach the quarterfinals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる→勝ち上がる：32270_kachiagaru⟧: to win and move up; nearly the same
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}く→勝ち抜く：22972_kachinuku⟧: to win through to the end, surviving every round
